description: The Gainsight Community MCP connects your Customer Community to ChatGPT. Surface unanswered questions, identify content gaps, and pull engagement trends through natural language. Review moderation queues, browse leaderboards, and audit community structure without waiting on a custom export. Purpose-built for community managers and CS teams managing Gainsight-powered communities at scale.

defaultPrompt: How is the community performing this quarter compared to last quarter?

Show me anything in the moderation queue and the most active discussions from the last 7 days.
